question.text: To qualify as an Angel Investor for investing in an Angel Fund (sub-category of Cat I AIF), an individual must have net tangible assets of at least:

explanation.text: The Logic: An Angel Investor must have net tangible assets of at least Rs. 2 crore (excluding the value of principal residence) AND have early-stage investment experience, serial entrepreneurship experience, or 10+ years of senior management experience. The Trap: The Rs. 2 crore specifically excludes the principal residence — so a person with only a Rs. 3 crore house and no other assets doesn't qualify. Cross-Exam Context: Angel fund/investor criteria are tested in X-A.
